info.title: Okra API Reference
info.description:
# Hello there!

Welcome to the API reference for Okra's APIs!

## About Okra

Okra provides the infrastructure layer that powers the next wave of financial innovation by unlocking the power of Open Finance. Okra connects to thousands of banks using a secure open API, removing the complexity and enabling seamless access to financial information and payment infrastructure.

## About the API reference

The API documentation is stored in an [OpenAPI v3.0 specification](https://swagger.io/specification/) file, using JSON format.

## Resources

To learn more about Okra's APIs and how you can integrate with them, check out the [documentation](https://docs.example.com/).

nin.description: National Identification Number (NIN) issued by Nigeria's National Identity Management Commission (NIMC).

refresh.description: You can request the API to refresh a user's identity profile by setting this parameter to `true`. Refreshing an existing identity profile means that any changes in personal details, like a new address or a change in the user's marital status will be reflected in the user's identity data. If there is no existing identity profile yet for a user with the requested NIN, the API creates a new one. If you set this parameter to `false`, the API creates a new identity profile based on the requested NIN.

testing.description: When `true`, this setting redirects your API call to the [Sandbox environment](https://docs.example.com/get-started/testing-your-integration). The data you receive is sandbox data, not real user data. When `testing` is `true`, you will not be charged for using this endpoint operation.

success.description: Use this setting in the Sandbox environment to test success and failure scenarios. When `true`, this setting forces a success response for the NIN name verify operation. When `false`, it forces a failure response.

includeRawImage.description: Use this setting to request the Identity API to return a URL that points to the user's identity image.

adjusted_receipt.description: Shows whether a receipt was adjusted as a result of a refund or for overcharging.

adjusted_type.description:
Shows the reason why a receipt was adjusted.
 - `duplicate-unbilled` means that the receipt is a duplicate of another receipt. Duplicate receipts should only be billed once.
 - `validated` means that receipt is verified to be a real API product call.

paid.description: Shows whether the bill was paid for.

ussd_pricing.description: Shows whether the USSD pricing scheme was used.

ussd_pricing_discount.description: Returns any discount that was used on the USSD pricing.

micro_lending_discount.description: Returns any discount that was used on the micro-lending pricing.

_id.description: The unique `ID` of a receipt record.

owner.description: The name of the account owner.

type.description:
Returns the type of receipt. The API returns:
 - `deposit` when you top up your wallet.
 - `api-call` when you use paid endpoints. Check out the API reference for [the list of paid endpoints](https://docs.example.com/reference/api-receipts#how-it-works).
 - `withdrawal` when you withdraw from your wallet.
 - `plan-fee` for subscription fee debits.
 - `refund` when you receive a refund on your wallet.

currency.description: Returns the currency used in the bill.

record.description: Returns the record ID for the creation of this receipt.

created_at.description: Indicates the date and time when the receipt was created. The timestamp value follows the ISO 8601 format, for example `2022-11-20`.

last_updated.description: Indicates the date and time when the receipt was last updated. The timestamp value follows the ISO 8601 format, for example `2022-11-20`.

receipts.description: Used during receipt adjustment. Returns an array of the receipts that Okra created in order to adjust this receipt.

vat.description: Returns the amount of value added tax charged on any deposit.

state_of_residence.description: The state where the user has residence.

mothers_maiden.description: The maiden name of the account owner's mother.

next_of_kins.description: The account owner person's closest living relative(s), as returned by the bank

score.description: This field shows how complete the user's identity profile is. `score` is calculated based on how many important data points, such as `address` and `email`, are returned by the user's bank. The resulting score is an integer between `0` and `100`.

watch_listed.description: This field shows whether the BVN connected to this identity profile is listed by the Central Bank of Nigeria for suspected fraudulent activities.

dti.description: The API calculates the debt-to-Income (DTI) ratio for a user, which is the percentage of total debt relative to total income, from the time the user’s account is created.

rc_number.description: The Registered Company Number of the account owner, as returned by the bank.

nin.description: The national identification number of the user.

photo_id.description: The photograpgh of the user as provided by the bank.

created_at.description: Indicates the date when the data point was first created. The timestamp value follows the ISO 8601 format.

last_updated.description: Indicates the date when the data point was last updated. The timestamp value follows the ISO 8601 format. The API only returns this field when the data point already exists.

enrollment.description: Lists details about the bank where the user is enrolled.

_id.description: Okra's unique ID for the photo.

url.description: The url pointing to the image.

image_type.description: The image type format of the photo, for example NIN photo.

bank.description: The institution that is the source of the image.

totalDocs.description: The total number of results that match the request.

limit.description: Returns the value of the `limit` parameter. Limit sets the number of results that the API returns in a single page. If you do not specify a value for `limit`, the API will limit the response to 10 results per page.

hasPrevPage.description: Shows when a previous page of results is available. This field always returns true when the value of `page` is greater than 1.

hasNextPage.description: Shows when a next page of results is available. When `true`, Okra recommends that you make subsequent requests to retrieve the following pages of results.

page.description: Returns the number of the current page. For example, if you set `page` to 1 in your request, the API will return the first page of results in the response.

totalPages.description: The total number of pages that the API returns.

pagingCounter.description: The index number of the first result on the current page. For example, if the value of `page` is 2 and `limit` is set to 10, then `pagingCounter` returns 11.

prevPage.description: The number of previous result pages. If the value of `page` is 1 and there is no previous page, the value of `prevPage` is `null`.

nextPage.description: The number of following result pages. Each page consists of up to `100` items. If there are not enough results for an additional page, the value is `null`.
